segments.he: גְּמָ׳ אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב: זוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה. אֲבָל חֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים, שָׁלֹשׁ נְעָרוֹת נִדְרֵיהֶן קַיָּימִין: בּוֹגֶרֶת, וִיתוֹמָה, וִיתוֹמָה בְּחַיֵּי הָאָב.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «Rav Yehuda said» that «Rav said: This» mishna is «the statement of Rabbi Yehuda,» who spelled out all the cases and listed nine young women whose vows are upheld. «But the Rabbis say» that it is unnecessary to go into such detail. Instead, they simply said: There are «three young women whose vows are upheld» and cannot be nullified: «A grown woman, and an orphan, and an orphan in her father’s lifetime,» i.e., a young woman who was divorced or widowed while her father was still alive and is considered an orphan in that her father no longer has jurisdiction over her.
